scope: Complete final collector and focused tests, static evidence admission and replay only. Native behavior, Rust semantics and runtime effects are outside this review.

observations.fact: Whole-target size/SHA admission and all inner/body checks precede output, snapshot and GNU subprocess creation.
Bounded ELF tables and file extents; each VA read requires one agreeing file-backed PT_LOAD and section.

Five exact raw FDE/CIE records and header mappings are bound; range and CIE backreference are checked after raw equality. Eighteen selected slots require exactly one overlapping RELA, symbol-zero type 8, exact addend/raw record and zero pre-relocation bytes.

Full GNU exports must form a contiguous exact-byte partition of each of five pinned bodies. Direct E8 and selected FF15/FF25 transfers have calculated target/slot metadata. This is not a generic disassembler or CFG proof.

Only the caller-selected installed GNU tool is invoked, with fixed options, a private read-only capture snapshot, clean environment and timeout. Command failures retain raw outputs; snapshot/tool identities are rechecked. No capture invocation, emulator or behavioral evaluator appears.

Replay allows only tool SHA/version and version-command raw-stream identities to differ; native exports, semantic records and native command/raw hashes remain exact. Final version filenames are fixed before metadata-directed reads and each version stream is separately hash-bound.

Below-outer-digest controls mutate actual anchored instruction/data bytes, RELA type/symbol/addend and CFI tails and require specific inner guard errors. Wrong-target test requires no output or subprocess. Mapping disagreement and missing mapping are checked.
Nine defined test methods include full collection/replay and a comparator control accepting only changed tool SHA before rejecting changed native-record bytes. This review did not execute them.

limits: No collector/test import, qualification execution, captured instruction execution, build or public edit by this reviewer.
No independent target rehash or GNU export in this review. Target identity is the source-declared pin; parent actual run evidence is separate.
Hardcoded raw anchors establish admitted byte identity; their corruption controls do not independently prove instruction semantics, callee effects, unwind/LSDA behavior or Rust correspondence.
The collector accepts an operator-supplied installed objdump path; its GNU version string is not an attestation of arbitrary executable provenance.
Malformed ELF outside the exact-target public admission is not a promised general parser API; some structural failures can surface as Python parse exceptions.
No assertion that every possible metadata/export corruption has a focused regression test, and no hosted CI/full-suite pass claim.
